title: About Adept
llmNone: Adi is using the built-in guide. Career scores and learning plans come from documented rules, not generated prose.
llmSummary: Research matching happens in the background; opening a page does not send your profile to a trend model. Adi may use a language model to choose from checked answers, but it cannot invent a role, course or score.

registryPurpose.minilm: Through RunPod: relates public research sentences to catalogue skills during background trend ingestion. Page loads serve stored snapshots.
registryPurpose.glm: Configured Adi model: selects validated, server-authored answer blocks. Names, figures and explanations come from checked application facts.
registryPurpose.gemini: Optional separately configured Adi fallback: selects the same validated answer blocks if the primary provider fails.
registryPurpose.embeddings: Optional skill suggestions for CV phrases and explicit skill searches; suggestions require your confirmation. Also the trend matcher once its equivalence test against MiniLM has passed (Google gemini-embedding-001, 384 dimensions): embeds public arXiv papers and skill labels and counts mentions above one stored threshold per model, chosen to match the mentions per paper measured with MiniLM.
registryPurpose.arxiv: Real completed arXiv submission weeks, retrieved through the public API, with a dated BLS baseline. Frozen October 2024 replay data is explicitly labelled; research attention is not observed job demand.
registryPurpose.bls: Occupational projections used as a labour baseline for estimated role outlooks.
registryPurpose.onet: Occupation taxonomy used to anchor curated Adept role mappings; Adept specialisations are not official O*NET titles.
registryPurpose.jobs: Automatic refresh uses documented Greenhouse, Lever and Ashby employer APIs, filtered by each posting’s Malaysian location and expiring after 14 days. Careerjet, Jooble and web3.career stay optional. Older exports may include other credited feeds. Remote-job boards (Himalayas, Jobicy, Remote OK, Remotive) are also read for the job board and role pages, each ad labelled “Remote · open to Malaysia” or “Remote · worldwide”; other pages list only postings located in Malaysia.
registryPurpose.mscert: Official certification descriptions and dated Malaysia exam fees; courses and certification exams are separate.
registryPurpose.awscert: Official AWS certification descriptions and exam fees.
registryPurpose.googlecert: Official Google Cloud certification descriptions and exam fees.
registryPurpose.iibacert: Official IIBA ECBA certification description and exam fee.
registryPurpose.iappcert: Official IAPP AIGP certification description and exam fee.
registryPurpose.bnm: Dated selling rates used to convert course and exam costs to Malaysian ringgit; converted prices are estimates.
registryPurpose.replit: Hosts the prototype and its managed PostgreSQL database.
registryPurpose.fonts: Inter font assets via Fontsource; current application styles use system Arial fallbacks.

llmCalls: {calls} model calls logged; {rejected} invented IDs rejected.
methodBody: Adept combines a skills catalogue, dated research signals and published course records to suggest a next step. See the data behind those suggestions, the AI we use and where the evidence stops.
limitsBody: Research attention is not job demand, and a recommended plan is not a guaranteed outcome. Course levels and future outlooks are estimates. You choose your direction; Adept never hires, rejects or admits anyone.
